subject.title: Add session workspace file preview editing

question: Should OpenClaw core add an admin-scoped `sessions.files.set` writer for session workspace text files, and require this PR to rebase onto the current file-viewer implementation before merge?
rationale: The patch adds a new Gateway write capability under an existing session workspace surface, which is a product/security-boundary decision automation should not accept by itself.

options.title: Accept admin-only save after rebase
options.body: Approve the new session-scoped text writer, require the contributor to rebase onto current main, and preserve the admin gate, fs-safe containment, text-only behavior, conflict checks, and tests.

options.title: Narrow the writer further
options.body: Ask for a smaller write contract, such as only already-previewed or transcript-touched text files, before accepting any core save path.

options.title: Defer core editing
options.body: Keep current main's read-only viewer behavior and close or pause this PR if maintainers do not want session workspace mutation in core.

recommendation.title: Accept admin-only save after rebase
recommendation.body: Approve the new session-scoped text writer, require the contributor to rebase onto current main, and preserve the admin gate, fs-safe containment, text-only behavior, conflict checks, and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current-main file viewer work and are closest to the product/security choice about widening the session workspace surface from read-only preview to admin writes.
